name: 71730 · El Dorado, AR
findings: ZIP 71730 (El Dorado) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71730 (El Dorado) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 71730 (El Dorado) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
